findings.claim: Two issues: 'evals' is masculine here but feminine later ('las evals dejan de parecer'), and 'uniones' loses the software metaphor of 'seams' (the standard rendering in Spanish dev literature is 'costuras').
findings.suggestion: 'Las evals premian las costuras aburridas.' and keep 'las evals' everywhere.

findings.quote: No pasa nada cuando el criterio lo merece.
findings.sourceQuote: That is fine when the judgment is worth it.
findings.claim: The referent of 'lo' is unclear and 'el criterio lo merece' does not carry the idea that the judgment call justifies the cost.
findings.suggestion: 'No pasa nada cuando la decisión realmente lo justifica.' or 'Está bien cuando el juicio lo vale.'

findings.quote: Si el modelo barato falla siempre en los mismos dos casos ambiguos
findings.sourceQuote: If every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases
findings.claim: Source says all cheap models fail those cases, which is the reason a more expensive default will not help either. The candidate narrows it to one model, weakening the argument for escalation logic.
findings.suggestion: 'Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos'

findings.quote: El objetivo es que el sistema sea más fácil de razonar.
findings.sourceQuote: The goal is to make the system easier to reason about.
findings.claim: 'fácil de razonar' is a calque; in Spanish one reasons 'sobre' a system, not the system itself.
findings.suggestion: 'El objetivo es que sea más fácil razonar sobre el sistema.' or 'que el sistema sea más fácil de entender.'

findings.quote: no llega con la verdad de referencia cosida con grapas
findings.sourceQuote: does not arrive with ground truth stapled to it
findings.claim: 'cosida con grapas' (sewn with staples) is an odd literalism; the natural verb is 'grapada'.
findings.suggestion: 'no llega con la verdad de referencia grapada encima' or simply 'adjunta'.

findings.quote: «Otros» es donde vive la cicatriz de producción.
findings.sourceQuote: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives.
findings.claim: Singular 'la cicatriz' reads as one specific scar; the source means accumulated scar tissue from incidents.
findings.suggestion: '«Otros» es donde viven las cicatrices de producción.'

findings.quote: tu router de modelos no es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho
findings.sourceQuote: your model router is vibes with a dispatch table
findings.claim: 'intuición' is neutral and loses the dismissive edge of 'vibes'. Dan's voice is deliberately blunt here.
findings.suggestion: 'tu router de modelos es puro feeling con una tabla de despacho' or 'pura corazonada con una tabla de despacho'.

findings.quote: title: No temas al enrutador de modelos
findings.sourceQuote: title: "Don't Fear the Model Router"
findings.claim: The title uses 'enrutador' while the entire body uses 'router'. Both are valid, but a reader arriving from the title meets a different word in the first paragraph.
findings.suggestion: Either 'No temas al router de modelos' or use 'enrutador' in the body. Given the body is already consistent on 'router', changing the title is the smaller edit.

findings.quote: Las tareas arriesgadas requieren aprobación explícita o una rama del flujo de trabajo.
findings.sourceQuote: Risky tasks require explicit approval or a workflow branch.
findings.claim: 'workflow' is kept as a loanword in headings and prose elsewhere ('Para un workflow', 'pasos de workflows') but becomes 'flujo de trabajo' in this list and in checklist item 5.
findings.suggestion: Pick one; 'workflow' matches the Mastra API naming used in the code.

findings.quote: La media importa menos que el conjunto de fallos.
findings.sourceQuote: The average matters less than the failure cluster.
findings.claim: 'conjunto de fallos' means 'set of failures' and drops the idea that failures cluster in one area, which is the setup for the next paragraph.
findings.suggestion: 'La media importa menos que dónde se concentran los fallos.' or 'que el clúster de fallos.'

findings.quote: Necesita analizar el JSON y comparar un campo.
findings.sourceQuote: It needs to parse JSON and compare one field.
findings.claim: 'analizar' for 'parse' is vague to developers; 'parsear' is the established term, and the same choice recurs in 'comprobar si el JSON se puede analizar'.
findings.suggestion: 'Necesita parsear el JSON y comparar un campo.' / 'comprobar si el JSON se parsea.'
